title: U.S. Army National Guard conducts medevac hoist traiing
description: U.S. Army UH-60 Black Hawk helicopters assigned to the 1-147th Aviation Regiment, Wisconsin Army National Guard, conduct medical evacuation hoist training during Patriot 26 at the combined arms collective training facility, Ft. McCoy, Wisconsin, Aug. 24, 2026. Patriot 26, an Air National Guard-hosted exercise taking place at Volk Field Combat Readiness Training Center, brings together approximately 1,000 Airmen and Soldiers from National Guard units across 35 states, along with federal, state and local agencies, to enhance domestic response readiness and interagency coordination during large-scale emergencies. (U.S. Air National Guard video by Staff Sgt. Josiah Meece)
keywords: disaster relief, DOMOPS, Black Hawk, National Guard Bureau, Wisconsin National Guard, PATRIOT26
